edits.anchor: # [R37 可达性收敛（W37）] 剪枝收敛后，仅保留从 entry 出发、沿正常
edits.repl:
# [R64-D3-J1 merge-bounded join prune] the W14-C reverse prune above runs
        # only for unbounded collection (`not merge`), so a merge-bounded branch BFS
        # that reaches its merge through a *shared post-if statement* keeps that
        # statement in the branch body (trade_info_utils.trade_operation: else arm
        # of `if operation == 'delete'` (entry 874, merge=loop header 654) swallows
        # block 1000 = `write_info.append(items)`, whose only outside predecessor is
        # 656, the enclosing `if items[0] in trade_id_list` condition block).  Same
        # structural criterion, restricted to the merge case; the child-structure
        # exemption additionally requires the sub-structure ENTRY to live inside the
        # branch (in in_set), so an *ancestor* LoopRegion that merely contains the
        # branch can no longer exempt its own header from external-pred detection.
        if len(collected) > 1 and merge is not None:
            _j1_in_set = set(collected)
            _j1_pruned = True
            while _j1_pruned:
                _j1_pruned = False
                for _j1_b in list(collected):
                    if _j1_b is entry:
                        continue
                    _j1_li = _j1_b.get_last_instruction()
                    _j1_none_tail = False
                    if _j1_li is not None and _j1_li.opname == 'RETURN_CONST':
                        _j1_none_tail = _j1_li.argval is None
                    elif _j1_li is not None and _j1_li.opname == 'RETURN_VALUE':
                        _j1_prev = [i for i in _j1_b.instructions
                                    if i.offset < _j1_li.offset
                                    and i.opname not in ('NOP', 'CACHE', 'EXTENDED_ARG', 'RESUME')]
                        _j1_none_tail = bool(_j1_prev) and \
                            _j1_prev[-1].opname == 'LOAD_CONST' and \
                            _j1_prev[-1].argval is None
                    if _j1_none_tail and any(_j1_p in _j1_in_set
                                             for _j1_p in _j1_b.predecessors):
                        continue
                    for _j1_p in _j1_b.predecessors:
                        if _j1_b in (_j1_p.exception_successors or set()):
                            continue
                        if _j1_p in _j1_in_set or _j1_p in stop:
                            continue
                        _j1_child = False
                        for _j1_r in self.regions:
                            if not isinstance(_j1_r, (TryExceptRegion, WithRegion,
                                                       LoopRegion, MatchRegion)):
                                continue
                            _j1_rb = getattr(_j1_r, 'blocks', None) or []
                            _j1_ent = getattr(_j1_r, 'entry', None)
                            if (_j1_p in _j1_rb and _j1_ent is not None
                                    and _j1_ent in _j1_in_set and _j1_ent is not entry):
                                _j1_child = True
                                break
                        if _j1_child:
                            continue
                        collected.remove(_j1_b)
                        _j1_in_set.discard(_j1_b)
                        _j1_pruned = True
                        break

        # [R37 可达性收敛（W37）] 剪枝收敛后，仅保留从 entry 出发、沿正常
